STEPS: Is the agent licensed? Checks 2,447 agents (MEA eMigrate, 8 Apr 2026). Adds up every payment against the ₹35,400 legal limit.
Records the promised job, visa and payments. Flags a visit visa or a different job at once.
Calls on landing: did the registered employer pick you up?
Salary, passport, food, threats, same job and city? Two missed calls in a row raise an alert (one, for a woman in housework).
Caseworker dashboard, English complaint-ready packet, and a Telugu SMS for the family, ready to send.
STARTED: Sat at Pravasi Prajavani, Praja Bhavan, Hyderabad, and heard real cases from Gulf workers' families: wrong jobs, unpaid wages, and months of waiting for papers.
Weekly Telugu check-in calls, agent and fee checks before departure, and ready case files for officials.
Showed it to the Pravasi Prajavani team, Nov 2026.
We were told we can start a pilot with Gulf worker families in Telangana, starting with Jagtial.
